description.value:
You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you take a Long Rest. With that pool, you can restore a total number of HP equal to Proficinecy Bonus x 10. You may, as an Action on your turn, place your hand on a creature and heal them any number of HP in your pool that you choose.

You may increase this pool by 5 HP for the cost of one Training Boon.
